description: Labelled diagnostic scenarios for evaluating the AnalysisAgent. Each case carries the three report sections exactly as the data agents format them, plus the expected decision. Used by AnalysisEvalTest (opt-in, calls the live model) and AnalysisEvalSetTest (structure validation, always runs).
